input.change_text: **Process cleanup**: Added `SIGKILL` fallback when `SIGTERM` handler blocks in `close()` (#729)

output.subject: SIGKILL fallback when SIGTERM blocks in close()
output.action_text: Upgrade `claude-agent-sdk-python` to 0.1.51+ if you have seen `close()` hang on shutdown. The SDK now escalates to `SIGKILL` when the subprocess `SIGTERM` handler blocks; no caller-side change required.
